reasoning_process.name: Hypothesis Formulation
reasoning_process.description: Evaluates vulnerable operational vectors: Price vs Volume growth, working capital stretch, or store additions masking SSSG.

reasoning_process.name: Autonomous Ingestion
reasoning_process.description: Harvests 12-13 quarters of P&L tables, balance sheet schedules, BSE earnings call transcripts, and peer disclosures without login barriers.

reasoning_process.name: Deterministic Arithmetic
reasoning_process.description: Computes exact YoY growth, DSO, DIO, and inventory expansion via Python to guarantee zero math hallucinations.

reasoning_process.name: Adversarial Red-Team Challenge
reasoning_process.description: Stress-tests findings against macroeconomic alternatives (raw material inflation, regional expansion, store maturation).

reasoning_process.name: Triangulated Proof & Falsification
reasoning_process.description: Synthesizes the discovery with an auditable 3-legged evidence trail and explicit future falsification boundaries.

element_1_the_discovery: Trent Ltd presents strong aggregate revenue expansion (+16.9% YoY), yet growth is overwhelmingly propelled by aggressive new store footprint additions while network inventory expanded +68.2% (reaching ₹2,289 Cr), indicating that top-line acceleration masks maturing sales productivity across legacy flagship locations.
element_2_why_it_matters: Top-line revenue driven by new store openings can create an optical illusion of growth that masks maturing or cannibalized sales at existing locations.
Balance sheet inventory expanded by +68.2% to ₹2,289 Cr (holding period at 51.2 days), elevating markdown and obsolescence risks if footfalls normalize.
Substantial lease liabilities and store upfront capital investments require sustained high sales throughput per square foot to preserve store-level EBITDA margins.
Customer receivables remain nominal (0.9 days) due to cash-and-carry retail operations, concentrating operational risk squarely in inventory velocity.

element_3_numbers.calculation_provenance: Computed deterministically via Python FinancialCalculator from audited quarterly results and balance sheet schedules.

element_4_timeline: Retail Footprint & Inventory Scaling: Network inventory grew from ₹1,361 Cr (Mar 2023) to ₹2,289 Cr (Mar 2026) (+68.2%)

element_6_counterargument: New retail store cohorts typically require 18 to 24 months to reach full sales maturity; near-term working capital absorption and inventory stocking are standard operational hallmarks of aggressive retail footprint scaling.
element_7_falsification_condition: Same-store sales growth (SSSG) exceeding +8.0% YoY for two consecutive quarters, coupled with inventory turnover days compressing below 51.2 days alongside positive free cash flow expansion.

element_8_evidence_strength.rationale: Audited quarterly revenue confirms top-line acceleration, but store-level maturation cycles provide a legitimate operational counter-rationale.
